changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Rule') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Rule]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [RuleTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [Threshold] [decimal](4, 3) CONSTRAINT [DF_Rule_Threshold] DEFAULT (0) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [SourceID] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [KeyHash] [varchar](250) NULL, [FieldHash] [varchar](250) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Rule] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Rule' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Color') begin alter table [dbo].[Rule] add [Color] varchar(7) null end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Rule' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Threshold') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Rule] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_Rule_Threshold]; alter table [dbo].[Rule] drop column [Threshold]; end

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Rule_RuleType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Rule] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Rule_RuleType] FOREIGN KEY([RuleTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[RuleType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Rule] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Rule_RuleType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Rule_RuleTypeID_SourceID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Rule_RuleTypeID_SourceID] ON [dbo].[Rule] ( [RuleTypeID] ASC, [SourceID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Rule_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Rule] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON delete Asset where Object = 'Rule' and ObjectID in (select ID from deleted) END

changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Rule_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Rule] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON INSERT INTO [dbo].[Asset] ([AssetTypeID],[State],SourceID,[Object],[ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy], Color) SELECT T.ID, 1, O.SourceID,'Rule', O.ID, O.[CreatedOn], O.[CreatedBy], O.[UpdatedOn], O.[UpdatedBy], O.Color FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'RuleType' and T.ObjectID = O.RuleTypeID END

changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Rule_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[Rule] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON update T set T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn, T.SourceID = S.SourceID, T.Color = S.Color from Asset T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'Rule' and T.ObjectID = S.ID END
